I don't really know how to start this, so I'll just ask.
She's on her phone in bed after midnight. When I roll over, she turns the screen away.
Who is Wren talking to that late at night?

Desmond. I've shaken his hand at the company picnic. Firm grip 😔
She texts me 'late meeting, don't wait on dinner' more often than she used to.
What are her late meetings with Desmond called?

That sounds like something I'm not supposed to know about.
She used to tell me about her day. Now it's always 'it's handled.'
What is the confidential review with Desmond actually about?

I feel stupid now 🥲
She drives out to my dad's farm near Millersburg most weekends to help my brother. I should be grateful.
But I keep doing the math on the miles.
How many times has she filled up her tank in Millersburg over the past 60 days?

A repair shop. At that hour. Maybe the farm really is falling apart.
She always texts me that she's asleep by ten out there, the work wears her out.
What time was she still awake at the farmhouse one of those nights?

So much for early nights.
The weekend I drove down to see my mom, she texted that she was stuck on the farm the whole time.
Where did Wren really go that weekend?
questions.hint: Check her Calendar, then her Wallet.

onboarding.text: I'm Bram. I teach high school chemistry, so I like things that have an explanation. Lately my wife doesn't give me one. Late meetings. Weekends away. A phone face-down on the nightstand.
onboarding.label: Bram

onboarding.text: Wren laughed at my tie at a friend's wedding, and I've spent every year since trying to make her laugh again. Eight years married. A little house in Wooster. An old dog who snores.
onboarding.label: Bram & Wren

onboarding.text: Wren runs HR at Harlan Agri Equipment. Sharp, private, impossible to rattle. Since my dad died, she drives out most weekends to help my younger brother on the family farm near Millersburg.
onboarding.label: Wren

onboarding.text: She's at an offsite today and left her personal phone charging on the counter. I've never once looked at it. I can't trust my own eyes right now. Please look for me. Just tell me the truth.
onboarding.label: Bram

msgs.text: WREN. I have news. We have a date. September 12!!
Congratulations!! 🎉 Mom just told me about the mill venue, it looks amazing
Will you be a bridesmaid? I know I should ask properly but I'm too excited

Put us both down for now. I'll confirm if that changes

Obsessed

Noted. Flight is booked, landing mid-afternoon
Mom says she'll pick you up from the airport
Tell her I'll take a shuttle. She shouldn't drive in that traffic
She won't listen but I'll tell her
Cousin!! Mom says you're coming up to the lake in September??
Hoping to! Still sorting out the schedule
Come come come. I'll make the cardamom buns
Okay that's a bribe and it's working 😂
Did you see Aunt Karen's text about the rummage sale lol
She's already told me twice. I'm getting the full story tomorrow
Good luck 😆 Grab a coffee, it's long
How's the new job?
Honestly better than I expected. My manager actually listens
Rare. Hold on to that one
Sending you photos of the cabin dock, they redid it
Beautiful! Is the old rope swing still there?
Of course. Some things are sacred
I'm so nervous. Is that normal
Completely normal. You'll be fine. You two are good together
Thank you 🥹 Sleep well
You too. Love you
Getting back around 7? I made chili.
Leaving the office now. Save me a bowl.
Always.
Biscuit threw up on the rug again. Calling the vet at 8.
Ugh. Was it the grass or the sock?
Sock. Probably. I'm still sorting the evidence 😔
Vet says watch him today, bland food only.
Rice and chicken tonight. I'll pick up chicken at Kroger.
Happy Valentine's. Don't buy flowers, I mean it.
Too late. They're in the car.
Bram.
Sorry. 🥲
I'll love them. Thank you.
Parent-teacher night ran over. Home by 8.
No rush. Leftover lasagna?
Perfect.
A sophomore asked if sodium is just fancy salt. I almost cried.
Proud of you for not crying 😂
Held it together. Barely.
Can you grab Biscuit's meds at the vet? I'm stuck in a benefits meeting.
Yes. Picking up on the way home.
Got them. They gave him a cookie. He's a hero now.
Your mom called me by accident. We talked about her tomatoes for ten minutes.
Welcome to the family 😂 Sorry.
Dinner at Linden Court Pizza? I don't want to cook.
Yes. Order the usual, I'll be 15 min.
Don't forget the recycling goes out today.
Already at the curb.
Sorry, I know I forget sometimes.
Calling Mama for Mother's Day. You coming on the line?
Yes, give me five minutes.
Marcus asked if we can watch his beagle in June. I said ask you.
Fine by me, Biscuit likes her.
Last day of finals review. I feel like an unbalanced equation.
Go sit on the porch. I'll bring wine.
Pilates, then Buehler's. Need anything?
Oat milk. And those pretzels.
Heading out to the farm, they need hands for the wheat.
Okay. Drive safe. Tell Silas hi.
Leaving now. Home by nine-ish.
Drive safe. I saved you a plate.
Farm again today, sorry. Back tomorrow night.
No apology needed. I feel bad you're doing it instead of me.
You've got summer school grading. It's fine.
Fireworks at the park later? Biscuit hates them.
Let's stay in with him. Movie?
Deal.
Late meeting, don't wait on dinner.
Okay. I'll save you some.
Home. Thanks for saving me a plate.
At the farm till tomorrow night.
Okay. Biscuit says hi.
Late one again tonight. Eat without me.
Okay. Hope it's not too heavy 😔
Leaving for Mama's in an hour. Biscuit's food is on the counter. Marcus has the spare key.
Safe drive. Tell her hi.
Made it. Mama made jollof. I ate three plates and feel guilty.
Have fun at your mom's. I'm stuck out here all weekend, the baler's broken again.
Poor baler. Tell Silas good luck.
Will do.
Heading home now. Should be back by 9.
Late meeting again, sorry. Soup in the fridge.
Going to bed. Asleep by ten out here, the work wears me out 😴
Sleep well. Miss you.
Heading home soon.
Okay. Biscuit's waiting at the window.
Running late, don't wait on me.
Farm again. Back tomorrow evening.
Okay. I'll take Biscuit to the park.
On my way home.
Late one, sorry. Fridge has leftovers.
It's okay. I'll keep the porch light on.
Offsite shuttle leaves at 6:30. I'll be up early, don't wake up.
I'll make coffee for the road. Good night.

Hi, yes, that works. My husband will be home.
Great, we'll text when we're on the way.
On our way, about 15 minutes out.
Thanks, the door is unlocked, side entrance
All done. Replaced the cartridge and the supply line. Invoice is on the way by email.
Got it, thank you. Bram says it's dry as a bone.
Glad to hear it. While we were there we noticed the water heater is about twelve years old. No rush, but call us if you want a quote.
Noted, thanks. I'll think about it.
Hi Wren, following up on the water heater quote. We have an opening on July 24 if you'd like to book.
Can you do the quote only first? Not ready to replace.
Absolutely. Sending a written estimate by email today.
Received, thank you
Kessler Plumbing: Your appointment is scheduled for tomorrow between 1 and 3 PM. Our tech will call 30 min before arrival.
Kessler Plumbing: Your tech Dave is on the way, ETA 20 minutes.
Thanks, my husband is home and the side door will be unlocked
Kessler Plumbing: Job complete. Replaced the shutoff valve under the kitchen sink. Invoice emailed.
Received, thank you. Water pressure is much better
Kessler Plumbing: Glad to hear it! A review would mean a lot to our small team.
Happy to. Posted five stars
Kessler Plumbing: Thank you, Wren!
Wooster Family Dental: Wren, you're due for a cleaning. Call us or reply BOOK to schedule.
BOOK
We have May 29 at 8:00 AM or June 3 at 3:30 PM. Which works?
May 29 at 8 please
Confirmed for May 29 at 8:00 AM. Please arrive 10 minutes early.
Reminder: your appointment is tomorrow at 8:00 AM. Reply C to confirm.
C
Thanks for visiting today! Your next cleaning is due in November.
Hi Wren, Dr. Patel wanted to flag one small cavity on your last X-ray. Would you like to book a quick filling?
Yes. Anything early morning in July?
July 17 at 7:30 AM is open.
Booked, thanks
Reminder: filling appointment tomorrow at 7:30 AM.
Your balance of $38.00 is due. Pay online at the link on your statement.
Wooster Family Dental: Hi Wren, you're due for a cleaning. Reply YES to see available times.
YES
Wooster Family Dental: We have the 11th at 8:00 AM or the 18th at 3:30 PM.
The 18th at 3:30 please
Wooster Family Dental: Confirmed for the 18th at 3:30 PM with Dr. Ames. Reply C to cancel.
Wooster Family Dental: Please complete your intake form before your visit: link in email.
Done, submitted this morning
Wooster Family Dental: Thank you! See you soon.
Okay what are we reading next? I vote something light after that last one 😅
Seconding. My brain is fried
Light is fine. Nothing over 350 pages.
Rules lawyer Wren lol
What about the new Anne Tyler? Short and sad in a nice way
Fine by me
Works. I'll put a hold on it at the library, they usually have a few copies.
Reminder: next meeting is at my place, I'm making lemon bars
Yes please
I'll bring wine. White or red?
Whatever you bring I won't turn down
Did anyone finish? I'm only at chapter nine
Page 150. Don't judge
Finished last night. It's short, so no excuse 🙂
Show off
Thanks for coming everyone, great talk
The lemon bars were dangerous
I took the leftovers home. Bram says thank you.
July pick time! Hannah it's your turn
Okay okay. I want a mystery. Something with a lake house.
Ooh yes
As long as nobody dies on page one.
Someone always dies on page one, Wren
lol
Going with The Last Cottage on Birch Lake. 340 pages, I checked 😉
Wren approved. Placing my hold now.
Can we move July to the 23rd? Kid's recital is on the 21st and I'll be wrecked
23rd works for me
Same
Fine here. Whose turn to host?
Mine, I think. Dana you can't host, you have the recital stress 😂
Ha. Thank you
Okay I'm at the twist and I'm NOT okay
No spoilers!!
I'm not saying anything. Just that I guessed the gardener.
WREN
Kidding. Mostly.
Great night everyone. Hannah, that pasta salad 👏
Next up is Colleen's pick. Pls nothing sad
No promises 😈
Poll time! Next pick: the Irish saga, the thriller, or the memoir?
Thriller. I need pages that turn themselves
Memoir for me, I'm tired of plots 😂
I'll go with the saga. Audiobook available!
Three-way tie. Priya, tiebreaker?
Saga. Sorry Dana
Fine. But I'm picking the wine
Fair trade
Where are we meeting this time? My place is a disaster
Mine is okay, but the porch light is out
We can bring candles. Mine, then?
Yours. I'll bring cheese
Crackers from me
And dessert from me. Lemon bars, no really
Hey. Bram said you helped him with the eulogy. Thank you. It was perfect.
He did the hard part. I just typed. How's Mama holding up?
She's strong. Aunt Ngozi's staying with her this week.
Do you know if Dad kept the insurance papers in the study or the barn office?
Study I think. Bottom drawer, blue folder. I'll look when I'm down.
You're the only organized Okafor. Seriously.
Is Bram okay? He says 'fine' to everything.
He's grieving the quiet way. Call him, he'd like that.
I will. I'm bad at calling.
I've noticed 😂
Thanks for the help with the books today, sis.
Anytime. Your receipts are a crime scene.
Ha. Guilty.
Got a bakery rec in Millersburg for when Mama visits?
Hershberger's. Get there before nine or the cinnamon rolls are gone.
Perfect, thanks.
Seed arrived. Planting starts this week if the rain holds.
Good luck. Send pictures.
Bring Biscuit next time? The barn cats need some discipline.
Bram would miss him too much. Maybe.
Thanks for the hands today. Wheat's almost done.
Glad to help.
Rain's coming. Might lose a day of cutting.
First load in. Old combine's running like a champ.
Look at that. Dad would be proud.
Mama's asking about Thanksgiving already 😂
Tell her we'll be there.
Thanks for the weekend, sis. Place wouldn't run without you.
Heading home now. Talk soon.

messages.title: Mama Joy, Bram, Silas, Aunt Ngozi

msgs.text: My children. Your father went to be with the Lord this morning. Peacefully, in his sleep.
Mama. I'm leaving now. Silas, are you at the house?
I'm at the house. He's... yeah. Come.
Oh Joy. Emeka was a good man. I'm coming to you in Columbus tonight.
Mama, I'm so sorry. We're on our way.
Service is tomorrow at eleven. Wear something warm, the church is cold.
I'll bring Dad's beret, if that's alright, Mama.
Yes, my son. He would like that.
Thank you all for today. Eat something. Sleep.
Thank you for standing next to me, Silas.
Always, big bro.
Reminder: Easter is April 5, I'm cooking, nobody argue.
Yes Mama 😂
Happy Easter everyone! Joy, the jollof was perfect.
Thank you for having us, Mama.
Silas, did the bank settle the seed for this season? Your father always worried in May.
Seed loan's covered, nobody worry about it 👍
Proud of you, little brother.
Thank you, Silas. Your father would be proud.
Happy Mother's Day, Mama. We love you.
Happy Mother's Day, Mama ❤️
Love you Mama 🌻
My blessings, my children.
Thinking of Emeka today. Father's Day will be hard.
Me too, Mama. 😔
Dad would be hassling us about the beans right now.
Thinking of him too, Mama.
Happy Fourth everyone! Stay cool.
Bram, is the car ready for the drive? I've started the stew.
Leaving soon, Mama.
Okay. We're here now. This one's locked, so nobody glances at it by accident.
Good call. I hate texting you from the shop number, my hands shake every time.
Mine too. Get some sleep, you were up at five.
Can't. Still smell your coffee in the kitchen.
Stop 🥲
Wheat's coming in earlier than I thought. Come out this weekend?
I'll be there by noon. Keep the porch light on.
Always.
Bram called me twice yesterday just to talk about Dad's truck. I almost told him.
Don't. Not like this. Not over the phone.
I know. I hate lying to him. He's the one person who never lied to me.
I hate it too. I think about it every time I pull out of the driveway.
Saved you a funnel cake. It's a crime how good it was.
You ate half of mine and I let you. That's love 😂
Asked him about selling me his half. He laughed.
What did you say?
Said I was kidding. Wasn't.
If he sells me his half, the east forty is yours. The house, the pond, all of it. I promise.
You don't have to promise me anything.
I want to. I mean it.
Header's running. Come see it when you can.
Soon. Text me when you're off the tractor.
Kickoff for the benefits packet next month. Can we sync on timing?
I can have the carrier rate sheets by the end of next week
I'll draft the employee FAQ. Last year's had a typo in the HSA section
I will never live that typo down 😅
Gail, can you book the conference room for the info sessions?
On it. I'll do two sessions, morning and afternoon, so the shop floor can come
Rate sheet draft is in the shared folder. Dental went up about 4 percent
Thanks Rick. Can you flag anything above 5 percent so I can look at it before the leadership review?
Will do
FAQ draft v1 posted. Please be gentle
Read it. Great, but I'd simplify the section on deductibles. People's eyes glaze over
Agreed. I'll use the coffee analogy again
Printer on the second floor is jammed again. Printing the packet at the front desk instead
Put in a ticket with IT Help Desk too, please
Done. They said 'within two business days' which means never
Info session slides need the new logo. Who has the file?
It's in the brand folder. The one that says 'FINAL final'
Of course it is
Quick check: do we have a signer for the vision vendor contract?
I'll sign this afternoon once legal gives the okay
Perfect. I'll hold the packet until then
Lunch is on me if we finish the packet by the end of the month 🥪
You are now legally obligated to buy it, we have witnesses
Hahaha. Deal
Final FAQ is up. Spell check run three times
Wonderful, thank you Noelle
Session room is reserved for both slots. I ordered donuts for the morning one 🍩
Gail, you are a hero
We're in great shape. Thanks everyone
Go home, Wren 😄
Did you want me to grab chicken thighs or breasts for tonight?
Thighs. And the good rice, not the minute kind
Okay. Thighs.
Sorry, they were out of the good rice. Got jasmine. Is that ok?
Jasmine is fine. Thank you
Dentist called the house phone. They moved your cleaning
Ugh, to when?
Next week, 8:15 AM. I wrote it on the fridge calendar
You're the best. I'll add it to mine
Can you let the dog out at noon? I have back to back meetings
Already did. He's snoring on the couch now
Good boy. Thank you
Gutter guy came by. Quote is $340 for the whole house
That's fair. Say yes?
I said yes. I felt bad haggling, so I didn't
You don't have to haggle
Okay 🥲
What do you want for the cookout? I'm making the pasta salad
I can do burgers. Is that too basic?
Burgers are perfect
I'll grab buns at Kroger. Do you want the brioche ones?
Yes. And the pickles you like
School emailed about the chem lab inventory. Summer cleanout, I have to go in tomorrow morning
Need me to drop you off?
No, I'll bike. Need the exercise
Pharmacy says your refill is ready. I'm nowhere near CVS today
I'll pick it up on my way home
Wait, the kitchen sink is dripping again. I think it's the washer, not the whole faucet
Call Kessler Plumbing? Their number is in the junk drawer
I'll try replacing it first. It's basically a small reaction between me and a rubber ring
😂 Don't flood the kitchen
Fixed it. Only used two towels
Proud of you
Pizza from Linden Court tonight? My treat
Morning Wren. Just confirming the quarterly headcount numbers go to the board packet on the 15th
Confirmed. Gail is finalizing the tables and I'll send them to you for review by the 12th
Good. Keep the summary to a page
Wren, the dishwasher in the break room is leaking. Facilities is on it but FYI
Thanks. Put a sign on it so nobody runs it
Already did. It says 'Do Not Feed the Dishwasher'
Perfect
New intern cohort starts next month. Do we have laptops for all of them?
IT said they have four ready, need two more. I'll ask for a rush
Thanks both
Reminder: open enrollment packets go out at the end of the month. Please proofread your sections.
Mine's done. Added the new dental FAQ.
Thank you. Ron, can you approve the budget line for the wellness stipend?
Approved. Keep it under what we spent last year.
Wren, I'd like to move the safety training up. Insurance carrier wants it done by fall
We can run it in September. I'll circulate dates for the plant and the office
Good. Thanks for being on top of it
Candidate interviews for the plant supervisor role are booked. I put the panel schedule in the shared calendar.
Got it. I'll sit in on the second round.
Reminder: company picnic is next month. Noelle is collecting potluck signups
Signing up for potato salad. Wren, you in?
I'll bring lemonade and the folding chairs from my garage
Ron wants to know if he's allowed to man the grill
Tell him yes, with supervision 😄
I heard that. I've been grilling since before you could vote
Yes sir. Supervised anyway 😊
Someone ate my yogurt from the fridge again. This is a formal complaint 😤
Filed under 'Break Room, Unresolved'.
Out of office tomorrow, appointment. Gail has the keys to anything urgent
Got it. Rest up
Offsite agenda is final. Please be in the lobby at 7:30.
Will do.
Did you see the new bakery on Liberty? They have cardamom buns
No! Adding that to the list. When are you free to go?
Saturday morning, before the line gets long
I'll be at the farm side of the family thing. Following weekend?
Fine, I'll suffer until then 😂
My sister is visiting and wants to do a winery day. Want to come?
Tempting. What's the date?
The 27th
I'm free that day, count me in
Yay. I'll designate a driver. Not it
That was the best day. My face hurts from laughing
Your sister is hilarious. Tell her she's invited to everything
She already adopted you 😂
Book club pick for next month, vote: the lighthouse one or the one with the dead sister?
Lighthouse. I can't do another dead sister.
Fair. Lighthouse it is 🍷
Wine at mine before? I got that pinot you liked.
Yes please. I'll bring the cheese from Buehler's.
Question: do I need a blazer for the kids' school fundraiser or is a sundress ok?
Sundress. No one wants to feel like they're at a board meeting
Says the woman who wears a blazer to the grocery store
It's a very good blazer
You okay lately? You seem tired.
Just work. Lots of long days.
Okay. Pilates tomorrow? I'll drag you if I have to.
6:30 at the Y. I'll be there.
Podcast rec: the one about the cold case in Oregon. I binged four episodes on the drive
I've had it queued for weeks. Okay, tonight I start it
Don't listen alone in the dark
Too late, I did. Checking the locks now
😂😂 told you
Pharmacy was a zoo today. A man tried to return an opened box of allergy pills 😩
Only one box? Rookie numbers.
Hahaha. Dinner Thursday? Sushi?
Sushi works. Let me check my calendar and confirm tomorrow.
Walk tomorrow morning? I need to move and gossip
Yes. Meet at the trailhead at 6:30?
Ouch, but fine. I'll bring coffee
Thanks for the walk. I needed it
Me too. Same time next week?
Obviously ☕
Can you take the lighthouse book back to me? I want to reread the ending.
Of course. Bringing it to Pilates.
You're the best. Night! 😘
Good morning Wren, it's Aunt Ngozi. Bram gave me your WhatsApp. I hope that's alright
Of course, Aunt Ngozi! So nice to hear from you
I am sending you the jollof recipe I promised. Please do not use a lot of pepper at first
Thank you. I'll try it this weekend and send a photo report 😊
I will be waiting. The secret is patience, you cannot rush the tomato
I tried it. Bram says it's very close to yours. I think he's being kind
Bram is always kind. But if he said close, then you did well. Next time more onion
Noted 😄
How is your mother-in-law Joy? I have not heard from her
She's doing alright. Busy with her church group. I'll tell her you asked
Please do. Family should call each other more, I keep telling everyone
You're right. I'm bad at it too
I am sending a little parcel for you and Bram. Some spices and a wrapper cloth. It leaves the post office tomorrow
You really don't have to! That's so generous
It is nothing. You are family
The parcel came today! The cloth is gorgeous. Bram took a long time looking at it. He went quiet and smiled
It belonged to his grandmother's pattern. I am happy he liked it
I'll frame a corner of it for the hallway if that's alright
Yes, yes. That would make me proud
Wren, how is your work? Bram says you are very busy these days
I am. It's a season of paperwork. But I like the people
Good. Do not let work eat your whole life. I tell Bram the same
I'll try. Promise
I will visit Ohio when the weather is cooler. Maybe October. Will you have space?
Always. We'd love to have you. Let us know the dates and we'll pick you up from the airport
Wonderful. I will bring you the real pepper soup spice
Good night Wren, God bless your home
Good night, Aunt Ngozi 🙏
Okay ladies, vote time. July pick: the lighthouse mystery or the memoir everyone keeps raving about?
Memoir. I need something that isn't a body in a lighthouse
Lighthouse! I already bought it 😅
Wren, you're the tiebreaker
Memoir. Dana, you can read the lighthouse one on the porch and tell us the ending
Betrayed by my own club
Memoir it is. Spoon Market again? Their back room holds all of us
Yes please. I'll bring the lemon bars
I'll do the wine. Red and a white
Is anyone else only on chapter 4? I'm so behind
I'm on chapter 9. It picks up, I promise
I finished it on a flight. Cried near the pretzels
😂 no spoilers
Reminder: we meet tomorrow at 7. Doors at Spoon Market open at 6:30
Running about ten minutes late, work is a zoo
We saved you the chair by the window
Thanks for hosting, that was a great discussion. Dana, your hot take on the mother was wild
I stand by it
Someone left a scarf. Gray with little stars?
Mine! I'll swing by Spoon Market after my run
Next pick? I want something light. Maybe a rom-com?
Hard no on rom-coms 😂
What about the one about the beekeeper? The library has six copies
Wayne County library has it as an ebook too. I just checked it out
Beekeeper it is then
Quick poll: next month's date. Early or late in the month?
Late for me, I'm away at the start
Late works
Late is fine by me too 👍
Locking it in for late August then
Does anyone have a good hummus recipe? I'm hosting snacks
Tahini, lemon, way more garlic than you think. Ice water makes it fluffy
Stealing that
I'm 40 pages into the beekeeper book. The bees are stressing me out
That's the point 🐝
See you all soon xx
Instructor says the reformer room is closed next week for new floors
Noooo. I just got used to the springs
We can do mat class in the studio downstairs
Mat class is secretly harder. Just saying
I'll bring my own mat, the YMCA ones smell like a gym bag
Coffee after? My treat
Yes! Spoon Market?
I can't, I have a dentist thing. Rain check
My hamstrings hate me after yesterday
Same. Walking down stairs like a baby deer
New instructor starts next week. Her name is Cass. Apparently very intense
Intense how
A friend said she counts out loud in a very calm voice and you still want to cry
I'm in
Cass was a delight. I can't feel my core
That's the idea 🙃
Does anyone want to do the 5K at the park next month? Just for fun
I run most mornings, so yes. I'll pace anyone who wants
I will walk it and eat a pretzel after
Honest and valid
Heads up, parking at the Y is torn up. Use the back lot
Thanks, you saved me
I'm skipping this week, my back is complaining
Rest up. Ice and a heating pad, not both at once 😄
Feel better!
Cass said hi to you both and asked where you were
Back this week, tell her I'm sorry in advance
Happy Midsummer, everyone! Anyone doing anything festive this year?
Just a potluck with the neighbors. I'm making herring, don't tell your mother
I heard that. Dale, no more herring in my fridge
Happy Midsummer from Ohio! We grilled and ate on the porch
Wren, send us a photo next time, we miss your face
Will do. Promise
Dale's 70th is coming up! Let's plan something small at the lake house.
Small is a lie. Karen, you'll cook for forty.
Twenty-five. Tops.
I can bring the rhubarb dessert!
Wren, will you and Bram make it up?
I'll try, Mom. Work is hectic, but I'll let you know soon.
Reminder: reunion potluck at the lake is in September. Please sign up for a dish
I'll bring the lefse, and some of that cardamom cake
Wren, can you do the green salad?
Sure. I'll do the salad. Not sure I can make it up there, will confirm closer to the date
Understood. It'd be so nice if you could
Anika got her nursing acceptance letter!! 🎉
Congratulations, Anika! So proud of you
Thank you!! I'm terrified and excited
Both is correct. That's what growing up feels like
Photo from the dock this morning. Fish were not impressed.
😂 Classic Dale.
Does anyone have a good dentist in Minneapolis? Mine retired
The one on Lake Street is good. I'll send his number
Thanks Kay
Please send me your sizes for the matching shirts. I'm kidding. Mostly.
Medium. And no.
Love you all. Drive safe when the time comes.
Thinking of everyone. Love you all
Love you too, kiddo ❤️
Group hug from Dale 🤗
Hi sweetheart, did you get the box I mailed? Should be there by now
It came yesterday! Thank you for the lefse. I'm rationing it
Good. Butter and sugar only, none of that fancy jam
Yes ma'am 😄
Dr. appointment went fine. Blood pressure is a little high but she's not worried
Mom, take it seriously. Are you cutting back on salt?
I'm trying. Dale keeps bringing over pickled herring
Tell Dale I said stop
The tomatoes are coming in already. Remember when you used to hide in the garden with a book?
I do. You'd call me for dinner and I'd pretend I couldn't hear
You heard me every time
Can you do a call Sunday? I want to show you the new kitchen curtains
Of course. After church?
Yes. About two
Love the curtains. The yellow is very you
They were on sale. I'm very proud of myself
How's work? You sounded tired on the phone
Busy. Benefits season is coming up and I'm behind on everything. I'm okay
You always say okay
Because mostly it's true. I'll rest soon
Your cousin Anika got into the nursing program!
That's wonderful! I'll text her
Maybe send a card too. She likes paper
Will do
Did you see the storm on the news? Is it going to hit Ohio?
Just some rain here. We're fine
Good. Tell Bram I said hello and eat something green
I'll pass it along 😊
Thinking about driving down to see you in the fall. Is that too much?
Not at all. I'd love that. We'll make up the guest room
Wonderful. I'll bring the good coffee cake
Talk Sunday. Love you, Mom
Hello from Wooster Animal Clinic! This is a reminder that your senior wellness exam is due. Would you like to schedule?
Yes please. He's been slower on the stairs lately, so I'd like the vet to look at his hips too.
Absolutely. Dr. Patel has openings July 14 at 4:15 PM or July 16 at 8:30 AM.
July 14 at 4:15 works.
Booked! Please bring a fresh stool sample if you can. Small container, we'll have one at the front desk if you forget.
Reminder: appointment tomorrow at 4:15 PM. Reply C to confirm.
C
Thanks for coming in today! Dr. Patel recommends starting the joint supplement and a half dose of the anti-inflammatory with food. Prescription is ready for pickup.
Thank you. Can I pick it up Thursday after work?
Yes, we're open until 6 PM on Thursdays.
Hi Wren, checking in. How is he doing on the new medication?
Much better. He took the stairs twice this morning without stopping at the landing 🥹
That's wonderful to hear! We'll send a refill reminder in about three weeks.
Hi, I'd like to book a ride from Wooster to Akron-Canton Airport for July 21, early morning flight.
Hello Wren! What's your flight time and how many passengers?
Departure is 7:20 AM. Just me, one carry-on and one checked bag.
We'd recommend pickup at 4:45 AM from your address. Is 418 Linden Court still correct?
Yes, that's right.
Confirmed. Fare is $68 flat, card on file will be charged the day before. Your confirmation number is ACS-40718.
Also need a return pickup on July 23, landing around 9:50 PM.
Added. We track the flight, so a delay won't be a problem.
Reminder: your pickup is tomorrow at 4:45 AM. Driver will text when outside.
Your driver Marcy is outside in a white Sprinter van.
Coming out now, thanks!
Flight 1190 landed. Your driver will meet you at door 3 by baggage claim.
Thank you, walking out now. Trip was great, I'll leave a review.
Hi Wren! This is Paws & Suds. We have a cancellation this Saturday at 10:00 AM if you'd like a bath and nail trim for your golden.
Yes, I'll take it! He's been smelling like a barn lately.
Ha, we've got you. Is he still okay with the dryer, or should we do a towel dry only?
Towel dry and low heat please. His joints get stiff if he stands too long, so short breaks would help.
Of course. We'll note it on his file. Price will be $62 plus tip.
Reminder: grooming appointment Saturday 10:00 AM.
Bram will drop him off, I have an early meeting. Is that okay?
Totally fine, just have him ask for Jess.
All done! He was an angel and smells like lavender. Ready for pickup anytime before noon.
Thank you so much! Bram is on his way.
We noticed a small lump near his left shoulder while grooming. Probably a fatty cyst, but worth mentioning to your vet next visit.
Thanks for flagging that. We were just at the clinic and I'll mention it at the next check.
Would you like to rebook for six weeks out? We're filling up for August.
Did you see the Wooster Rotary 5K is open for signups? Saturday morning, it's the one along the Kauffman trail
I did! I've been meaning to sign up. Are you running or walking it with your sister?
Running, sort of 😂 Jogging with long walking breaks. You'd lap me.
I'll jog with you. No lapping. I need an easy day anyway.
Okay you're a good friend. Signing us both up. $25 each, I'll cover and you get coffee after
Deal. Spoon Market after?
Obviously. Their oat latte is the only reason I'm doing this
Bib pickup is Friday at the YMCA lobby from 4 to 7. Can you grab mine if I'm late?
I'm there Friday around 5 for Pilates anyway. I'll get both.
Got them. You're number 214, you're 213. Safety pins included.
Thank you!! Starting to regret this lol. See you at 7:30 sharp
We did it!!! 41 minutes and I didn't die 😅
Proud of you. Latte's on me, I'm already in line.
Hi, this is Wren Okafor on Linden Court. The kitchen faucet has started dripping even when it's fully off. Do you have anything open this week?
Hi Wren, thanks for reaching out. We can come Thursday between 8 and 10 AM or Friday afternoon. Which works?
Thursday morning is great. Someone will be home.
Perfect, you're on the schedule. Dale will be your tech. He'll text when he's 15 minutes out.
Dale here from Kessler. About 15 minutes away.
Great, door's unlocked, the dog is friendly but will want to say hello 🙂
Replaced the cartridge and the supply lines under the sink. Total is $184.50, parts and labor. Invoice attached to the email on file.
Got it, thank you. Looks good and no more drip.
Glad to hear it. One tip: the shutoff valve under the sink is pretty old. We'd recommend swapping it next time we're out.
Noted. Can you give me a rough price for that so I can mention it to my husband?
Usually around $95 for the valve and labor if it's done together with another visit. Standalone is about $140.
Hi Wren, quick follow up from Kessler Plumbing. Everything still working okay with the faucet?
All good, thanks for checking. Bram says he'll call about the valve once the school year gets closer.
Sounds good. We're here whenever you need us.

notes.title: Eulogy — Dad
notes.body:
Eulogy — Dad (draft for Bram)

My father drove trucks for twenty-two years before he ever planted a seed. He used to say the road teaches you patience and the land teaches you humility.

In 1994, Dad bought 160 acres on Ridge Line Road with what he'd saved driving trucks. People told him soybeans on that ridge was a gamble. He walked the fence line every Sunday anyway, hat in hand, like he was apologizing to the soil for doubting it.

He taught his sons to drive in his old truck, to read the sky before a storm, and to show up when someone needed hands.

Add: the story about the broken tractor and the neighbor's casserole. Keep it short. Bram will want to stop at the part about the truck.
